newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AT&T cut by Bear Stearns.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AT&T cut by Bear Stearns.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns downgraded AT&T Corp to neutral from buy, a Bear Stearns source said.
-- The stock ended at 51-1/2 Tuesday, down 5-5/8 after the company warned of an earnings shortfall in the second half of 1996.

-- "We continue to rate AT&T shares strong buy, realizing that we are one of the only ones left on the Street behind the stock," she said, referring to a series of brokerage downgrades that began with AT&T warning yesterday of weak earnings for the current and next quarters.
-- "Despite this, we believe that the shares represent a buying opportunity," Comfort said.
